recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit; further edits would be redundant unless a work group decides to change the ExampleScenario modeling guidance.
issue_request: FHIR-44494 was an Applied/Persuasive FHIR-core ExampleScenario clarification asking to explain the use of the containedInstance backbone. The resolution asked for rationale explaining that contained resources may need distinct references when the same instance appears in multiple scenario locations.
initial_application: Jira identifies Git master 313dcaaff7. That commit added the approved text as ElementDefinition.requirements on ExampleScenario.instance.containedInstance, and the current source still contains it.
additional_context: FHIR-44493 is the same contained-instance clarification family and adds companion ExampleScenario notes. source/fhir.ini has active ExampleScenario entries, Confluence minutes record FHIR-44494 as Persuasive, and no conflicting Zulip evidence was found.
reconciliation: No source change was made because source/examplescenario/structuredefinition-ExampleScenario.xml already preserves the Jira resolution in build-scope source.
